name: Dudhsagar Falls
facts: Sanctuary entry approx Rs 50 + jeep safari approx Rs 400-450 per person (full jeep approx Rs 2400-2500)
Jeep safari: 6:00 AM - 5:30 PM; ticket counter closes around 2:00 PM; closed during heavy monsoon (mid-June to September)
October to early June (best flow June-September, but access restricted in peak monsoon)
